subject: Confidential Aster launch pricing preview
body:
Elena,

For East Region launch planning, the final Aster annual platform price is USD 42,500. The approved introductory price is USD 35,500 for agreements signed by 2026-10-31. Public announcement remains embargoed until 2026-09-24 at 13:00 UTC.

Please keep this preview restricted to the current regional sales lead.

Product Marketing
